newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Veritas DGC estimates upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Veritas DGC estimates upped.

text.p: -- Hanifen Imhoff Inc said Friday it raised its estimates for Veritas DGC Inc's fiscal 1997 earnings to $1.25 a share from $1.15 and 1998 earnings to $1.60 from $1.40 a share.

-- Hanifen said it believes the outlook for the company is more favorable than street expectations now that problems in the company's Latin American operations are being addressed. Veritas DGC is also now seeing visible pricing improvements in Argentina, has reduced excess labor costs and tightened operational controls, Hanifen said.
-- Veritas DGC provides seismic data acquisition services to the oil and natural gas industry.
-- Its stock was up 1-3/8 Friday at 22.
